channel.title: Isle of Wight Radio - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Isle of Wight Radio (iwradio.co.uk)

item.title: Big Garden Birdwatch 2026: Isle Of Wight Residents Asked To Count Garden Birds
item.description: The RSPB’s Big Garden Birdwatch returns later this month, giving Isle of Wight residents the chance to help track how garden birds are faring across the UK.

item.title: West Acre Park Legal Battle Cost Isle Of Wight Council Over £150,000
item.description: A legal challenge over the controversial West Acre Park housing development has cost the Isle of Wight Council more than £150,000, councillors have been told.

item.title: Plans To Convert Newport Office Building Into Flats Refused
item.description: Plans to convert vacant office space in the centre of Newport into six residential flats have been refused by the Isle of Wight Council.

item.title: Cowes Care Home Residents Visit Island Art Exhibition In Newport
item.description: The sessions were described as fun and full of laughter, with residents and their families joining in.

item.title: Drivers Urged To Follow Official Diversion During Binstead Road Works
item.description: Island Roads is urging motorists to follow the official diversion route during ongoing highway improvement works on Binstead Road in Ryde.

item.title: Bay Church Of England School Praised For Inclusive Curriculum And Pupil Wellbeing
item.description: An Isle of Wight Church of England school has been praised by inspectors for its inclusive approach to education and strong focus on pupil wellbeing and mental health.

item.title: Union Inn Shelves Modern Extension Plans Following Resident Concerns
item.description: A proposal to ‘enhance’ an historic Isle of Wight pub with a roof terrace and pergola has been withdrawn after criticism from residents and the local town council.

item.title: Ventnor Slip In Top Of The Table Clash Against Tottonians
item.description: Ventnor suffered a frustrating 16–10 defeat in their top of the table clash with Tottonians, with handling errors and missed opportunities proving costly for the Islanders.

item.title: Southern Vectis Backs Hampshire And Isle Of Wight Air Ambulance As Official Charity For 2026 And 2027
item.description: Southern Vectis has announced it will support Hampshire and Isle of Wight Air Ambulance as its official charity partner for 2026 and 2027.

item.title: Isle Of Wight MP Vows To Keep Fighting Over Proposed Council Funding Cut
item.description: The Labour MP for Isle of Wight West says he will continue pushing the government for fairer funding for the Island, following warnings of a possible £13.4 million shortfall.
